message.content: Based on the discussions provided in the text, several individuals suggest adding picnic tables and other amenities for families to enjoy their time together. Specifically, Muradin Bronzebeard proposes adding cushions for the benches, which could lead to the idea of picnic tables. Additionally, Malfurion Stormrage suggests adding tables, umbrellas, and plants to make the seating area more comfortable and inviting. Therefore, Muradin Bronzebeard and Malfurion Stormrage are among those proposing picnic tables and other amenities for family gatherings.
